title: Overly complex controls and setup
summary: Review fragments in this topic mainly describe vehicle controls, functions, setup, and related app or registration steps as overly complex and difficult to use, with many examples left at undetermined sentiment despite clearly naming complexity concerns.

negative.summary: Negative reviews specifically criticize drive modes, controls, auto-hold access, and the car’s computerized systems for being overly complex, distracting, awkward, or hard to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews also mention excessive complexity in functions, controls, setup, registration, and app use, but the short fragments do not provide enough context to classify sentiment more precisely.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short, which limits sentiment certainty even when they mention complexity.
The topic includes related but not identical subjects such as in-car controls, overall setup, registration, and app usage, so it is not a single tightly defined issue.
